outcome: Biz aggregate bookings and revenue pulled in the admin are saved server-side and reused across reloads instead of being recalculated for every business.
authorizationBoundary: Implement and verify in the current candidate. Publication requires an explicit deploy instruction and verified production route.
affectedFamily: vacations, events and hourly rooms supported by the conversion endpoint
invariants: supplier data remains the source of truth and cached values never create or alter an order
phone-level contact details are not persisted in the aggregate snapshot cache
admin authorization and same-origin write protection remain required
a failed refresh never replaces a last known good snapshot
acceptance: A successful aggregate pull is durably stored by world, supplier business and exact date range.
The second identical pull returns the saved snapshot without another supplier request while it is fresh.
Opening or reloading the report returns saved matching snapshots immediately.
Stale data is refreshed, and supplier failure falls back to the last good snapshot with an explicit stale status.
A user can explicitly force a refresh without losing saved results when the supplier fails.
Focused persistence tests, admin regressions and the production build pass.
